title_or_table: Biographical Directory of Article III Federal Judges, 1789 to present, export file federal-judicial-service.csv (active judges only)
observation_period: Judges in active service on the export's latest record (latest commission date 2026-10-22); years counted to November 11, 2026
universe_or_base: 850 service records of Article III judges with no senior-status or termination date: Supreme Court, courts of appeals, district courts, and the Court of International Trade (the file's "Other")
unit: years, computed by the studio from commission dates to November 11, 2026, one decimal
vintage: FJC export as posted on November 11, 2026; the file states no as-of date
qualification: A judge who takes senior status still hears cases but leaves this count; vacancies are not in the file. Years in seat start at the commission for the current court, so a judge promoted from a district court counts from the promotion; years as a federal judge start at the first Article III commission

court_type.description: court type as the FJC labels it

commission_date.description: commission date for the current seat

years_as_federal_judge.description: years since the first commission, computed

printed_source_line: Source: Federal Judicial Center, Biographical Directory of Article III Federal Judges, judges in active service, as of November 11, 2026, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Judges on senior status are not counted; years computed by Oath & Action from commission dates.
notes: The export's appointing-president and party columns are left out of this file; a tenure chart does not need them
